C151.name: Babati Town Council
C151.documented: Lake Babati floods, drought on the surrounding plain, strong winds, and flash floods

area.en: Babati Town: Lake Babati shore and town streams
area.sw: Mji wa Babati: ufukwe wa Ziwa Babati na vijito vya mjini

risk.en: This area surrounds Lake Babati, which rises and floods nearby streets and farms in wet years, and town streams flash-flood after storms on the surrounding hills.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linazunguka Ziwa Babati linalojaa na kufurika mitaa na mashamba jirani katika miaka ya mvua nyingi, na vijito vya mjini hufurika ghafla baada ya dhoruba milimani.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build above the lake's highest known level, keep stream channels clear and keep goods off the floor. What raises the risk: building new houses or stores on the lake flats that were under water in the last wet year, and blocking the town streams with plots or waste. Know the higher street away from the lake and the streams that you will move to, and go when the lake creeps past its usual edge or heavy rain is reported on the hills; the streams rise within the hour. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya kina cha juu kabisa cha ziwa kinachojulikana, kuweka mikondo ya vijito wazi na kuhifadhi bidhaa juu ya sakafu. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba au maduka mapya kwenye tambarare za ziwa zilizokuwa chini ya maji mwaka wa mvua nyingi uliopita, na kuziba vijito vya mjini kwa viwanja au taka. Fahamu mtaa wa juu mbali na ziwa na vijito utakaohamia, na ondoka ziwa linapovuka ukingo wake wa kawaida au mvua kubwa inaporipotiwa milimani; vijito hujaa ndani ya saa moja. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C154.name: Mbulu Town Council
C154.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the Mbulu highlands, and a dry season on the lower slopes

area.en: Mbulu Town: highland town and steep valleys
area.sw: Mji wa Mbulu: mji wa nyanda za juu na mabonde makali

risk.en: This area is a cool highland town where steep slopes erode and slide in heavy rain, and hailstorms and strong winds damage roofs and crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa nyanda za juu wenye baridi ambapo miteremko mikali humomonyoka na kuporomoka wakati wa mvua kubwa, na mvua ya mawe na upepo mkali huharibu paa na mazao.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to keep slopes planted, build away from steep cuts and gullies and fix roofs firmly. What raises the risk: cutting into the slope behind a house, clearing the trees above it, and leaving roofs loosely fixed before the windy season. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open or water runs muddy during heavy rain; shelter in a solid building when hail or strong wind is forecast. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na makorongo na kufunga paa imara. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, kukata miti juu yake, na kuacha paa zisizofungwa imara kabla ya msimu wa upepo. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au maji ya matope yakitiririka wakati wa mvua kubwa; jikingeni kwenye jengo imara mvua ya mawe au upepo mkali unapotabiriwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C150.name: Babati District Council
C150.documented: drought, Lake Babati floods, strong winds, wildfire, and human–wildlife conflict toward Tarangire

area.en: Babati DC: Rift escarpment and Lake Manyara edge
area.sw: Babati DC: ukingo wa Bonde la Ufa na pembezoni mwa Ziwa Manyara

risk.en: This area runs from the Rift escarpment, where flash floods and debris flows rush down gullies, to the Lake Manyara edge where floods and wildlife affect farms.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linaanzia ukingo wa Bonde la Ufa, ambapo mafuriko ya ghafla na matope hushuka kwa kasi kwenye makorongo, hadi pembezoni mwa Ziwa Manyara ambapo mafuriko na wanyamapori huathiri mashamba.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes off gully mouths and flood channels, keep trees on slopes and use community deterrents against wildlife. What raises the risk: building below the gully mouths because the ground is flat and fertile, clearing the escarpment slopes, and farming right to the lake edge. Know the firm ground to the side of the gully that your household will move to, and go when heavy rain starts on the escarpment above, even if it is dry where you are; debris flows come without warning. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na midomo ya makorongo na njia za mafuriko, kuacha miti kwenye miteremko na kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga chini ya midomo ya makorongo kwa sababu ardhi ni tambarare na yenye rutuba, kukata miti kwenye miteremko ya ukingo, na kulima hadi ukingo wa ziwa. Fahamu eneo imara pembeni mwa korongo ambalo kaya yako itahamia, na ondoka mvua kubwa inapoanza kwenye ukingo juu yako, hata kama ulipo ni kavu; matope na mawe hushuka bila taarifa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C152.name: Hanang District Council
C152.documented: drought, strong winds, flash floods on the Hanang slopes, and wildfire

area.en: Hanang: Mount Hanang slopes and Katesh
area.sw: Hanang: miteremko ya Mlima Hanang na Katesh

risk.en: This area lies below Mount Hanang, where intense rain can send mudflows and debris down the slopes into Katesh and nearby villages, as happened in December 2023.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko chini ya Mlima Hanang, ambapo mvua kubwa inaweza kushusha matope na mawe kutoka miteremkoni hadi Katesh na vijiji jirani, kama ilivyotokea Desemba 2023.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to keep homes and markets away from gully mouths and drainage paths below the mountain and to keep trees on the slopes. What raises the risk: rebuilding in the paths that the December 2023 mudflow followed, clearing the remaining forest on the mountain, and cutting plots into the lower slopes; for new building choose ground outside those paths, and for houses already there agree the way out and move at the first heavy rain on the mountain. Know the firm ground to the side of the drainage paths that your household will move to, and go the moment heavy rain is reported on Mount Hanang, even at night; do not wait to see the water. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kujenga nyumba na masoko mbali na midomo ya makorongo na njia za maji chini ya mlima na kuacha miti kwenye miteremko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga upya kwenye njia zilizopitiwa na matope ya Desemba 2023, kukata msitu uliobaki mlimani, na kuchonga viwanja kwenye miteremko ya chini; kwa ujenzi mpya chagueni ardhi nje ya njia hizo, na kwa nyumba zilizopo tayari kubalianeni njia ya kutokea na ondokeni mvua kubwa ya kwanza inaponyesha mlimani. Fahamu eneo imara pembeni mwa njia za maji ambalo kaya yako itahamia, na ondoka mara mvua kubwa inaporipotiwa Mlima Hanang, hata usiku; usisubiri kuona maji. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C156.name: Kiteto District Council
C156.documented: drought on the Maasai steppe, strong winds, wildfire, flash floods, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Kiteto: dry rangeland and farmland frontier
area.sw: Kiteto: nyika kame na mipaka ya mashamba

risk.en: This area is semi-arid rangeland where drought kills pasture and livestock and expanding farms on grazing land cause conflict between farmers and herders.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nyika kame ambapo ukame huua malisho na mifugo na upanuzi wa mashamba kwenye maeneo ya malisho husababisha migogoro kati ya wakulima na wafugaji.

advice.en: For those living, farming and herding here, it helps to follow village land-use plans and agreed livestock routes, protect water points and sell livestock early in drought. What raises the loss and to conflict: opening farms across the agreed livestock routes, keeping more animals than the dry-season pasture can carry, and holding on to weak stock hoping for rain. Agree early, with the village and the neighbouring villages, where the herds and the families will move in a drought year, and move before the animals weaken; settle disputes through the committee, not at the water point. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kufuata mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi ya vijiji na njia za mifugo zilizokubaliwa, kulinda vyanzo vya maji na kuuza mifugo mapema wakati wa ukame. Kinachoongeza hasara na migogoro: kufungua mashamba kwenye njia za mifugo zilizokubaliwa, kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko malisho ya kiangazi yanavyoweza kubeba, na kung'ang'ania mifugo dhaifu kwa matumaini ya mvua. Kubalianeni mapema, na kijiji na vijiji jirani, mifugo na familia zitahamia wapi mwaka wa ukame, na hamieni kabla mifugo haijadhoofika; maleteni migogoro kwenye kamati, si kwenye vyanzo vya maji. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C153.name: Mbulu District Council
C153.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the highlands, drought on the lower plains, and strong winds

area.en: Mbulu DC: highland farms and Yaeda valley
area.sw: Mbulu DC: mashamba ya nyanda za juu na bonde la Yaeda

risk.en: This area has steep, intensively farmed highlands prone to erosion and landslides, and the dry Yaeda valley below where drought and flash floods affect herders.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina nyanda za juu zenye miteremko mikali na kilimo kingi zinazokumbwa na mmomonyoko na maporomoko, na bonde kame la Yaeda ambapo ukame na mafuriko ya ghafla huathiri wafugaji.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep terraces and trees on slopes, build away from gullies and plan water and grazing for dry years. What raises the risk: opening new fields on the steepest slopes, cutting into the slope behind a house, and camping in the dry Yaeda river beds. In the highlands, agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope and move there when cracks open or water runs muddy; in the Yaeda valley, know the raised ground away from the river beds and agree early where the herd will go in a dry year. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta na miti kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na makorongo na kupanga maji na malisho kwa miaka ya ukame. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba mapya kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, na kupiga kambi kwenye mikondo mikavu ya mito ya Yaeda. Nyanda za juu, kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au maji ya matope yakitiririka; bonde la Yaeda, fahamu eneo lililoinuka mbali na mikondo ya mito na kubalianeni mapema mifugo itaenda wapi mwaka wa ukame. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C155.name: Simanjiro District Council
C155.documented: drought, wildfire, flash floods, human–wildlife conflict, and tanzanite pit collapse at Mererani

area.en: Simanjiro: Maasai steppe and mining areas
area.sw: Simanjiro: nyika ya Kimasai na maeneo ya uchimbaji

risk.en: This area is dry Maasai steppe where drought hits pasture and water, and the Mirerani tanzanite mines where shafts flood and collapse in heavy rain.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nyika kame ya Kimasai ambapo ukame huathiri malisho na maji, na migodi ya tanzanite ya Mirerani ambapo mashimo hujaa maji na kubomoka wakati wa mvua kubwa.

advice.en: For those herding and mining here, it helps to protect dry-season grazing and water points, and keep mine shafts drained, supported and fenced. What raises the risk: working the shafts while rain is falling, digging without timbering, crowding houses at the shaft mouths, and keeping more animals than the dry-season water can serve. Keep everyone out of the shafts once rain starts and know the firm ground away from them that your household will move to; on the steppe, agree early where the herds and families will go in a drought year, and move before the animals weaken. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaofuga na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kulinda malisho ya kiangazi na vyanzo vya maji, na kuweka mashimo ya migodi bila maji, yaliyoimarishwa na kuzungushiwa uzio. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufanya kazi mashimoni mvua ikinyesha, kuchimba bila mihimili, kusongamanisha nyumba kwenye midomo ya mashimo, na kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko maji ya kiangazi yanavyoweza kuhudumia. Mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza na fahamu eneo imara mbali nayo ambalo kaya yako itahamia; nyikani, kubalianeni mapema mifugo na familia zitaenda wapi mwaka wa ukame, na hamieni kabla mifugo haijadhoofika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
